title: A Special Thank You To Bishop Nathanyel
cleanTitle: A Special Thank You To Bishop Nathanyel
segments: Bish Natalia I want to thank you for the
work you are doing and continue to do
and for what you want to do in Liberia
having seen the brothers here today and
uh listening to what they want to do I
can assure you that I also support them
in whatever way I can making sure that
the message of Love is spread and the
message of unity is brought to our
people through hard work and
understanding so I will be working with
them uh whenever the the need arises and
uh making sure that they spread a good
message of love and unity so I just want
to thank you for the work you're doing
and continue to do and I want to make
sure that I can assist you in helping
Liberia help themselves and that is the
emancipation of the mind so I just want
to thank you and we continue to thank
you so indeed I look forward to
thank you and God bless you for the work
you do
